scope: Worker TLS runtime state fix in isolation. Same production program object relinked with fixed runtime; no frontend/codegen changes. Correctness stress only, no timing benchmark. Shared root runtime.o left unchanged.
cause: SIGUSR1 GC handler used interrupted QBE RBX as runtime state. RBX actually held a List object; thread table lookup dereferenced 0x11 at handler_found_scan ELF+0x112c9.
